summary: Frontend review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability) completed with REQUEST CHANGES verdict. 2 high-severity blocking issues found: (1) useAutoSave.ts passes hardcoded empty bricks array instead of reading from sceneStore — auto-save never persists actual user work; (2) package.json has unscoped breaking changes including removed dependencies (immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8), major version bumps (zustand v4→v5, vite v5→v6), removed scripts, and package name change. 3 medium issues: tests use inline stubs instead of production imports, purgeSession uses raw IDBKeyRange, saveSnapshot has TOCTOU race on saveCount. Architecture, type safety, error handling, accessibility, and LLD compliance are all excellent. All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 are covered.

blocking_issues.title: Hardcoded empty bricks array — auto-save never persists actual user work
blocking_issues.description: triggerAutoSave([], ...) always saves 0 bricks. The hook must read actual scene state from sceneStore.getState() at save time.
blocking_issues.fix: Use useSceneStore.getState() inside the interval callback to read current bricks, camera, and metadata

blocking_issues.title: Unscoped breaking changes to package.json
blocking_issues.description: Removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8. Major bumps: zustand v4→v5, vite v5→v6. Removed scripts: lint:fix, format, format:check, type-check, test:e2e:ui. Package name changed.
blocking_issues.fix: Revert all changes except adding idb to dependencies and fake-indexeddb + globals to devDependencies

medium_issues.title: Tests use inline stubs instead of production imports
medium_issues.description: All 4 test files define inline implementations rather than importing from ../../src/... Now that production code exists, tests should import real modules.

medium_issues.title: purgeSession() uses raw IDBKeyRange.only() instead of idb wrapper
medium_issues.description: Inconsistent with rest of codebase. Should use getAllFromIndex pattern like purgeOldSnapshots().

medium_issues.title: saveSnapshot() TOCTOU race on saveCount
medium_issues.description: existingMeta read happens outside the atomic transaction. Mitigated by overlap guards.

positive_findings: Excellent module architecture with clean separation of concerns
Full idb library usage per LLD Section 13
WCAG-compliant ResumePrompt with proper ARIA attributes
All 7 data-testid attributes match E2E selectors
PersistenceError class with typed error codes
All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 covered

human_review_required.item: Gate 8 — Human review of blocking issues
human_review_required.reason: Two high-severity issues require coding agent fixes before merge
Human should confirm which dependency changes are intentional vs accidental

recommended_actions: Fix useAutoSave.ts to read actual scene state from sceneStore
Revert package.json to only add idb and fake-indexeddb
Update test files to import real production modules
